text: answer[signalcaption-be66daee]: 1 00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:04,000 This is a simple SRT caption example. Every line must stay under 42 chars. The clock starts at zero seconds. Cue blocks are separated by a blank line. 2 00:00:04,000 --> 00:00:08,000 Timestamps use comma as the millisecond delimiter, not a period. Keep it clean. UTF-8 encoding keeps every character safe. No extra metadata between cues, just text. 3 00:00:08,000 --> 00:00:12,000 VTT format works the same way. A header of WEBVTT precedes the first cue block. Settings lines are optional but allowed. Pick whichever format your tool requires. 4 00:00:12,000 --> 00:00:16,000 Check each line before publishing. Shorter lines read better on screen. Wrap naturally at word boundaries. Done.
